name: SunKissed Boho Summer Maxi Dress
description: The SunKissed Boho Summer Maxi Dress features a flowing full-length silhouette in soft chiffon fabric. Bohemian-inspired design with a V-neckline, tiered skirt layers, and adjustable waist tie belt. Lightweight and breathable, ideal for summer festivals, vacations, and evening outings. Available in solid and printed colorways.
shortDescription: Flowing chiffon bohemian summer maxi dress with tiered skirt and adjustable waist tie.
